text: Psalms 1–41 Psalm 1 Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked or stand in the way of sinners or sit in the seat of mockers.
and on his law he meditates day and night.
which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither. Whatever he does prospers.
They are like chaff that the wind blows away.
nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
but the way of the wicked will perish.
